* **Seller A [Ottervale Audio](https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/9t24zc/a):** 4.3 out of 5 stars (210 reviews)
* **Seller B [Brackmoor Sound](https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/9t24zc/b):** **4.8 out of 5 stars (1,900 reviews)**

There is no downside to choosing B - you pay the same and get the same headphones with lower risk.
